author: Yffe
content: Approach (acto-fixer, single file forge/src/contract_tv.rs): AUDIT — contract_tv discharge mapped every errors>=1 run to Divergent, including an rlimit-exhausted run (a results line counting the exhausted obligation as an error). Same #189-class bug body_tv fixed: a solver-budget timeout fabricated into a contract infidelity. The CompileAbort case was ALREADY honest (no parseable results line -> the _ arm -> Unverifiable). MINIMAL FIX: added is_rlimit_signal + an 'errors>=1 && rlimit_hit -> Unverifiable' arm AHEAD of the Divergent arm in discharge (mirrors body_tv::is_rlimit_signal). TEETH: a #[cfg(test)] mod divergent_teeth mirroring exec_tv/body_tv — faithful (x==1 prod==ref) -> Faithful; wrong prod (x<=1 for x==1, the <=-for-== divergence) -> Divergent; frame compile abort (undefined spec-fn req) -> Unverifiable; rlimit discriminator -> kept out of Divergent. Hand-derived verdicts (R-CHAR-3). Faithful corpus path unchanged.
